text: Stop. Every Manappuram branch earns about twelve thousand rupees profit a day.
Manappuram Finance runs five thousand three hundred and twenty eight branches. In just three months, April to June, it made five hundred and eighty five crore rupees in profit.
Divide that by every branch. About eleven lakh rupees a quarter, or roughly twelve thousand rupees, every single day.
How? You walk in with your gold. They test it, weigh it, and lend you about sixty five percent of its value, in minutes.
You pay interest. Their gold loans earn around eighteen percent a year. And if you do not repay, the gold covers the loan.
And the business is exploding. Gold loans hit fifty seven thousand crore, almost double in one year, as gold prices rose.
Eighty six percent of these gold loans are now taken online, by twenty six and a half lakh customers.
The plan? Five hundred new branches this year, and twenty five to thirty percent gold loan growth. Bain Capital is now a co promoter, and a new CEO takes charge in January.
The stock trades near three hundred and twenty four rupees. Market value, about thirty thousand crore.
But watch the risks. If gold prices fall, loans shrink and auctions rise. And bad loans in its vehicle finance arm jumped to thirteen percent.
Save this, and follow for more. Have you ever taken a gold loan? Yes or no?
